title: CogAdapt: Cognition-informed Sparse Adaptation of Code LLMs
title_zh: CogAdapt：基于认知的代码大语言模型稀疏自适应

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable of generating code. However, achieving stronger code-generation performance still often relies on costly model adaptation, i.e., fine-tuning pretrained model parameters. Meanwhile, prior studies have shown meaningful correspondence between how humans process code and how neural models allocate attention or internal computation. Building on this relationship, recent human-aligned learning approaches have used cognitive signals, such as attention or brain activity, to guide training and improve model performance. However, these methods typically still adapt a large portion of the model, leaving the training cost largely unchanged. This reveals an important gap: human cognitive signals may not only indicate what the model must learn from, but also help determine where adaptation is most useful within the model. Motivated by this insight, we investigate whether human responses during code reading correspond to the internal behavior of code models, and whether this correspondence can guide more selective and efficient model adaptation without sacrificing performance.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在生成代码方面的能力日益增强。 然而，要实现更强的代码生成性能，通常仍然需要依赖成本高昂的模型适配，即对预训练模型的参数进行微调。 与此同时，先前的研究已经表明，人类处理代码的方式与神经模型分配注意力或内部计算的方式之间存在有意义的对应关系。 基于这种关系，近期一些以人类认知为对齐的学习方法已利用注意力或脑活动等认知信号来指导训练并提升模型性能。 然而，这些方法通常仍然需要适配模型的大部分参数，因此训练成本基本没有改变。 这揭示了一个重要的空白：人类的认知信号不仅可能指示模型需要学习的内容，还可能帮助确定模型内部哪些部分最适合进行适配。 受这一见解的启发，我们研究了人类在读取代码时的反应是否与代码模型的内部行为存在对应关系，以及这种对应关系是否能够在不牺牲性能的前提下，指导更具选择性和效率的模型适配。

paragraphs.en: We present CogAdapt , a cognition-informed framework for task-dependent sparse adaptation of code models. CogAdapt first learns transferable program-level and token-level priors from human Electroencephalography (EEG) and attention data, then combines these priors with the frozen model’s response to each coding task to determine how much adaptation to allocate and which transformer blocks should receive updates. During fine-tuning, only the selected blocks are updated, while no new human recordings are required for inference. Across Qwen and GLM, we find consistent correspondence between human reading behavior and MoE computation. CogAdapt achieves the best pass@1 across both LiveCodeBench and BigCodeBench, including gains of 10.86 and 6.29 percentage points over matched regular fine-tuning on LiveCodeBench, while reducing gradient-eligible adaptation parameters by 86.21–87.21% . These results suggest that human comprehension signals can provide useful guidance for making code-model adaptation both more selective and more effective.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 CogAdapt，这是一个基于认知理论的框架，用于根据任务需求对代码模型进行稀疏适配。 CogAdapt 首先从人类的脑电图（EEG）和注意力数据中学习可迁移的程序级和词元级先验知识，然后将这些先验知识与冻结模型对每个编码任务的响应相结合，以确定应分配多少适配资源以及哪些 Transformer 块需要更新。 在微调过程中，仅选中的块会被更新，而推理阶段无需任何新的人类记录数据。 在 Qwen 和 GLM 模型中，我们发现人类的阅读行为与 MoE 的计算之间存在一致对应关系。 CogAdapt 在 LiveCodeBench 和 BigCodeBench 测试中均取得了最高的 pass@1 成绩，其中在 LiveCodeBench 上相比匹配的常规微调方法分别提升了 10.86 和 6.29 个百分点，同时将可梯度更新的适配参数减少了 86.21%–87.21%。 这些结果表明，人类的理解信号可以为代码模型的适配提供有效指导，使其更具选择性和效率。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable of generating code and supporting a wide range of programming tasks ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Nijkamp et al., 2023 ) . However, these advances come with substantial computational cost. Training and deploying large generative models require considerable GPU resources and electricity, and recent studies have raised growing concerns about their energy consumption ( Strubell et al., 2019 ; de Vries, 2023 ; Luccioni et al., 2024 ) . Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures provide a promising way to improve computational efficiency by activating only a subset of model components for each input, allowing model capacity to grow while reducing the computation required during inference ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024 ) . Nevertheless, sparse inference does not eliminate the cost of training and adapting these large models. MoE models still require substantial computation during training ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024a ) . Thus, an important challenge remains: while MoE models can selectively allocate computation during inference, how can we similarly make learning more selective during adaptation?
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在生成代码和支持各种编程任务方面的能力日益增强（Chen 等人，2021；Nijkamp 等人，2023）。 然而，这些进步也带来了巨大的计算成本。 训练和部署大型生成模型需要大量的 GPU 资源和电力，近期的研究也引发了对其能源消耗日益增长的担忧（Strubell 等人，2019；de Vries，2023；Luccioni 等人，2024）。 专家混合（MoE）架构提供了一种提升计算效率的有前景的方法：它仅对每个输入激活模型组件的一个子集，从而在增加模型容量的同时减少推理所需的计算量（Shazeer 等人，2017；Fedus 等人，2022；Jiang 等人，2024；DeepSeek-AI 等人，2024）。 尽管如此，稀疏推理并未消除训练和适配这些大型模型的成本。 MoE 模型在训练期间仍然需要大量的计算资源（DeepSeek-AI，2024；Pan 等人，2024a）。 因此，一个重要的挑战依然存在：虽然 MoE 模型可以在推理阶段选择性地分配计算资源，但我们如何在适配阶段同样使学习过程更具选择性呢？

paragraphs.en: Existing parameter-efficient methods address part of this problem by reducing how many parameters are updated. Parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA reduce the number of trainable parameters or the memory required for adaptation ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Dettmers et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) . However, these methods determine adaptation largely from properties of the model itself, providing limited external guidance about where learning would be most useful. In contrast, the human brain operates under strong metabolic constraints, which have been associated with energy-efficient neural coding and computation ( Attwell and Laughlin, 2001 ; Levy and Calvert, 2021 ) . This contrast motivates a different question: can human cognitive signals provide prior knowledge about where computation is most valuable, and use that knowledge to guide which parts of an LLM should be adapted?
paragraphs.zh: 现有的参数高效方法通过减少需要更新的参数数量，解决了该问题的一部分。 诸如 LoRA 之类的参数高效技术减少了可训练参数的数量或适应所需的内存（Hu et al., 2022；Dettmers et al., 2023；Zhang et al., 2023）。 然而，这些方法主要根据模型本身的特性来确定适应方式，因此无法提供关于何处学习最有益的有限外部指导。 相比之下，人类大脑在严格的代谢限制下运行，而这些限制与高效的神经编码和计算有关（Attwell and Laughlin, 2001；Levy and Calvert, 2021）。 这种对比引发了一个不同的问题：人类的认知信号能否提供关于何处计算最有价值的先验知识，并利用这些知识来指导 LLM 的哪些部分应当被适应？

paragraphs.en: Human cognition therefore provides a promising source of prior knowledge for more selective model adaptation. Eye-tracking studies show that developers follow selective and non-linear reading patterns and allocate different amounts of attention to different code regions ( Bansal et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2025 ) . A growing line of work has consequently modeled programmer attention from eye movements, aligned human reading behavior with neural code representations, and incorporated human attention into code models ( Bansal et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Alakmeh et al., 2024 ; Wallace et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . More recent studies extend this direction to Code LLMs by transferring cognitive signals into downstream model adaptation ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026d ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Together, these studies suggest that human cognitive signals capture information about where developers concentrate their processing effort, and that this information can provide useful supervision beyond conventional input–output training data. However, balancing the performance benefits of human-guided adaptation with training efficiency remains an open challenge. This motivates our work: can human EEG and attention measurements collected during code comprehension provide useful guidance about which parts of a code model should be updated? If so, fine-tuning could focus on a small, task-dependent subset of transformer blocks rather than adapting the model uniformly.

paragraphs.en: We propose cognition-informed sparse adaptation of code LLMs, called CogAdapt . Our approach uses EEG and attention measurements from human code reading to inform both the emphasis of code supervision and the allocation of adaptation gradients. Figure 1 illustrates the local human–model correspondence that motivates the study. We structure our study in two connected steps. First, we conduct an exploratory analysis to examine whether human attention and EEG responses systematically correspond to MoE computation at the same code regions and across model depth. The resulting correspondence is distributed across blocks rather than concentrated in one fixed location, motivating task-dependent adaptation. Building on this finding, CogAdapt converts human signals into transferable priors and combines them with frozen-model responses to dynamically select a small set of transformer blocks for each training task. Only these selected blocks are adapted, while inference requires no EEG or attention input.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于认知理论的代码 LLM 稀疏自适应方法，称为 CogAdapt。 我们的方法利用人类阅读代码时的脑电图（EEG）和注意力测量数据，指导代码监督的重点以及自适应梯度的分配。 图 1 展示了本研究的核心依据——局部的人类与模型之间的对应关系。 我们将研究分为两个相互关联的步骤。 首先，我们进行探索性分析，考察人类的注意力和脑电图反应是否与模型在相同代码区域及不同模型深度上的计算存在系统性对应关系。 分析结果显示，这种对应关系分布在多个模块中，而非集中在某个固定位置，这为任务依赖的自适应提供了依据。 基于这一发现，CogAdapt 将人类信号转化为可迁移的先验知识，并将其与冻结模型的反应相结合，从而为每个训练任务动态选择一组小型的 Transformer 模块。 只有这些被选中的模块会被自适应，而推理过程则无需任何脑电图或注意力输入。

sents.en: We propose cognition-informed sparse adaptation of code LLMs, called CogAdapt .
sents.zh: 我们提出了一种基于认知理论的代码 LLM 稀疏自适应方法，称为 CogAdapt。

sents.en: Our approach uses EEG and attention measurements from human code reading to inform both the emphasis of code supervision and the allocation of adaptation gradients.
sents.zh: 我们的方法利用人类阅读代码时的脑电图（EEG）和注意力测量数据，指导代码监督的重点以及自适应梯度的分配。

sents.en: Figure 1 illustrates the local human–model correspondence that motivates the study.
sents.zh: 图 1 展示了本研究的核心依据——局部的人类与模型之间的对应关系。

sents.en: We structure our study in two connected steps.
sents.zh: 我们将研究分为两个相互关联的步骤。

sents.en: First, we conduct an exploratory analysis to examine whether human attention and EEG responses systematically correspond to MoE computation at the same code regions and across model depth.
sents.zh: 首先，我们进行探索性分析，考察人类的注意力和脑电图反应是否与模型在相同代码区域及不同模型深度上的计算存在系统性对应关系。

sents.en: The resulting correspondence is distributed across blocks rather than concentrated in one fixed location, motivating task-dependent adaptation.
sents.zh: 分析结果显示，这种对应关系分布在多个模块中，而非集中在某个固定位置，这为任务依赖的自适应提供了依据。

sents.en: Building on this finding, CogAdapt converts human signals into transferable priors and combines them with frozen-model responses to dynamically select a small set of transformer blocks for each training task.
sents.zh: 基于这一发现，CogAdapt 将人类信号转化为可迁移的先验知识，并将其与冻结模型的反应相结合，从而为每个训练任务动态选择一组小型的 Transformer 模块。

sents.en: Only these selected blocks are adapted, while inference requires no EEG or attention input.
sents.zh: 只有这些被选中的模块会被自适应，而推理过程则无需任何脑电图或注意力输入。

paragraphs.en: We present CogAdapt , a cognition-informed framework for sparse adaptation of code models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to use human code-comprehension signals to guide where a code model should adapt. CogAdapt transfers cognition-derived priors to downstream tasks without requiring new human data .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CogAdapt，一个基于认知理论的代码模型稀疏适应框架。 据我们所知，这是首个利用人类对代码的理解信号来指导代码模型应进行何处适应的研究。 CogAdapt 无需新的数据，即可将源自认知的先验知识迁移到下游任务中。

sents.en: We present CogAdapt , a cognition-informed framework for sparse adaptation of code models.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 CogAdapt，一个基于认知理论的代码模型稀疏适应框架。

sents.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to use human code-comprehension signals to guide where a code model should adapt.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，这是首个利用人类对代码的理解信号来指导代码模型应进行何处适应的研究。

sents.en: CogAdapt transfers cognition-derived priors to downstream tasks without requiring new human data .
sents.zh: CogAdapt 无需新的数据，即可将源自认知的先验知识迁移到下游任务中。

paragraphs.en: We identify local correspondence between human reading behavior and MoE computation. Across two MoE architectures and four code categories, 75.0–83.3% of analyzed regions show positive correlations between human attention or EEG responses and model computation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出人类阅读行为与 MoE 计算之间的局部对应关系。 在两种 MoE 架构和四类代码中，75.0–83.3% 的已分析区域显示出人类注意力或 EEG 响应与模型计算之间的正相关关系。

sents.en: We identify local correspondence between human reading behavior and MoE computation.
sents.zh: 我们识别出人类阅读行为与 MoE 计算之间的局部对应关系。

sents.en: Across two MoE architectures and four code categories, 75.0–83.3% of analyzed regions show positive correlations between human attention or EEG responses and model computation.

paragraphs.en: We show that human processing demand corresponds to MoE computation across model depth. The depth–time heatmaps reveal systematic but architecture-dependent relationships between EEG responses and model computation, with different internal signals dominating in Qwen and GLM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，人类的处理需求与模型深度各层中的 MoE 计算相对应。 深度-时间热图揭示了 EEG 反应与模型计算之间系统性的、但依赖于架构的关系，其中 Qwen 和 GLM 中占主导地位的内部信号各不相同。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that cognition-informed sparse adaptation improves code generation with fewer gradient-eligible parameters. On LiveCodeBench, CogAdapt improves pass@1 over matched all-block fine-tuning by 10.86 points for Qwen and 6.29 points for GLM, while reducing adaptation parameters by 86.21–87.21% .
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，基于认知的稀疏适应方法能够以更少的梯度可用参数提升代码生成效果。 在 LiveCodeBench 上，CogAdapt 方法使 Qwen 的 pass@1 指标相比匹配的完整块微调提升了 10.86 分，GLM 提升了 6.29 分，同时将适应参数减少了 86.21%–87.21%。

paragraphs.en: This example motivates the central question of our work: if difficult code regions consistently attract both stronger human processing and stronger model computation, can human comprehension signals help guide where and how a code model should adapt? CogAdapt investigates this question across programs and model architectures, and then uses the resulting human-derived signals to guide sparse adaptation for downstream code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 这个例子引出了我们工作的核心问题：如果复杂的代码区域持续吸引更强的人类处理能力和更强的模型计算能力，那么人类的理解信号是否能够帮助指导代码模型应在何处以及如何进行自适应？ CogAdapt 通过多种程序和模型架构来研究这个问题，并利用由此获得的人类衍生信号来指导下游代码生成的稀疏自适应。

paragraphs.en: Our work connects three lines of research: learning to generate code, measuring human program comprehension, and comparing human and model processing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作将三个研究方向联系起来：学习生成代码、衡量人类对程序的理解，以及比较人类与模型的处理方式。

paragraphs.en: Early pretrained models developed representations that connect code with its descriptions ( Feng et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Generative code models extend this foundation by learning to produce programs from specifications and surrounding context. Research on Codex and CodeGen established the potential of large-scale code training for function synthesis and multi-turn programming ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Nijkamp et al., 2023 ) . Infilling models and code-specialized foundation models further support editing within existing programs and conditioning on longer code contexts ( Fried et al., 2023 ; Rozière et al., 2023 ) . Efficient adaptation raises a further question: where should a limited training budget be spent? Low-rank adaptation restricts learning to compact weight updates, and adaptive rank allocation distributes that budget according to parameter importance ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) code models offer a related form of selectivity by activating only some experts for each token ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024 ) . Selective adaptation has also been studied within parameter-efficient and layer-wise training. LISA samples layers for optimization, LoRA-drop uses adapter outputs to assess importance, and CKA-based layer selection uses representational change to identify adaptation locations ( Pan et al., 2024b ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Ogawa et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的预训练模型发展出了能够将代码与其描述连接起来的表示（Feng 等，2020；Wang 等，2021；Wang 等，2023）。 生成式代码模型通过从规格说明和周围上下文中学习生成程序，扩展了这一基础。 对 Codex 和 CodeGen 的研究确立了大规模代码训练在函数合成和多轮编程方面的潜力（Chen 等，2021；Nijkamp 等，2023）。 Infilling 模型和专门针对代码的基础模型进一步支持在现有程序内进行编辑，并基于更长的代码上下文进行条件生成（Fried 等，2023；Rozière 等，2023）。 高效适配引发了另一个问题：有限的训练预算应该分配到哪里？ 低秩适配将学习限制在紧凑的权重更新上，而自适应秩分配则根据参数的重要性来分配该预算（Hu 等，2022；Zhang 等，2023）。 专家混合（MoE）代码模型通过仅对每个词元激活部分专家，提供了一种相关的选择机制（DeepSeek-AI 等，2024）。 选择性适配也在参数高效和逐层训练中被研究过。 LISA 为优化而采样各层，LoRA-drop 利用适配器输出评估重要性，而基于 CKA 的层选择则通过表示变化来确定适配位置（Pan 等，2024b；Zhou 等，2025；Ogawa 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Neuroimaging research treats program comprehension as a cognitive activity that can be studied beyond completion time and correctness. Early functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) studies demonstrated the feasibility of observing brain activity during source-code comprehension, and subsequent studies examined its relation to working memory, attention, familiarity, and code review ( Siegmund et al., 2014 ; Peitek et al., 2020 ; Floyd et al., 2017 ; Ivanova et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2020 ) . Studies of neural efficiency and cortical representations examine how familiarity and programming skill relate to the processing of source code ( Siegmund et al., 2017 ; Ikutani et al., 2021 ) . Electroencephalography (EEG) provides complementary evidence through changes in brain activity associated with programming experience and mental workload ( Crk et al., 2016 ; Kosti et al., 2018 ) .

paragraphs.en: Human measurements also help assess what makes particular code difficult to understand. paragraphs.en: Neuroscience provides empirical benchmarks for characterizing the representations learned by language models. Neural predictivity is associated with next-word prediction performance, while brain–model correspondence varies across training stages and representational depths ( Schrimpf et al., 2021 ; Caucheteux and King, 2022 ) . These findings motivate examining multiple model layers and processing signals. Human attention also offers a complementary perspective on language processing. Comparisons between LLM self-attention and eye-saccade patterns indicate that scaling improves correspondence with human reading attention, whereas instruction tuning primarily increases sensitivity to instructions ( Gao et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 神经科学为描述语言模型所学到的表示提供了经验基准。 神经预测性与下一个词的预测表现相关，而大脑与模型之间的对应关系在不同训练阶段和表示深度上存在差异（Schrimpf 等人，2021；Caucheteux 和 King，2022）。 这些发现促使我们研究模型的多个层和处理信号。 人类的注意力也为语言处理提供了补充视角。 对比大型语言模型（LLM）的自注意力和眼跳模式可以发现，模型规模的扩大能增强其与人类阅读注意力的对应关系，而指令微调则主要提升了对指令的敏感度（Gao 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: For code, associations between fMRI recordings, program properties, and learned representations demonstrate shared information between human and artificial program processing ( Srikant et al., 2022 ) . Beyond such comparisons, human attention has become a training signal for code models. Cognitive simulation based on ACT-R generates code-reading scanpaths from limited human observations, reducing dependence on large eye-tracking datasets ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Observed visual attention can also supply token-level loss weights for code-model fine-tuning ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Integrating simulated scanpaths with training weights based on cognitive salience and attention order further supports transfer from C++ reading patterns to Java tasks ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) . Together, these approaches demonstrate how observed and simulated reading behavior can inform model adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 在代码领域，fMRI 记录、程序属性与学习到的表示之间的关联表明，人类与人工程序处理之间存在共享信息（Srikant 等，2022）。 除了这类比较之外，人类的注意力也已成为代码模型的训练信号。 基于 ACT-R 的认知模拟能够从有限的人类观察中生成代码阅读扫描路径，从而减少对大规模眼动追踪数据集的依赖（Zhang 等，2025b）。 观察到的视觉注意力也可以为代码模型的微调提供词元级别的损失权重（Zhang 等，2026b）。 将模拟扫描路径与基于认知显著性和注意力顺序的训练权重相结合，进一步支持了从 C++ 阅读模式到 Java 任务的迁移（Zhang 等，2026d）。 这些方法共同表明，观察到的和模拟的阅读行为如何能够指导模型适应。

paragraphs.en: We present CogAdapt , a cognition-informed framework for task-dependent sparse adaptation of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) code models, as shown in Figure 3 . The central idea is straightforward: human EEG and attention measurements indicate which code regions require greater cognitive effort during comprehension , while our human–model analysis reveals where corresponding changes in model computation appear across transformer blocks . CogAdapt transfers this information to downstream code-generation tasks and uses it to determine which training examples and code regions receive greater emphasis and which transformer blocks are updated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CogAdapt，这是一个基于认知理论的框架，用于根据任务需求对专家混合（MoE）代码模型进行稀疏自适应，如图 3 所示。 其核心思想十分直接：人类的脑电图和注意力测量结果可以表明，在理解过程中哪些代码区域需要更多的认知努力，而我们对人类与模型的分析则揭示了模型计算在哪些 Transformer 模块中出现了相应的变化。 CogAdapt 将这些信息传递到下游的代码生成任务中，并利用这些信息决定哪些训练样本和代码区域应得到更多关注，以及哪些 Transformer 模块需要进行更新。

paragraphs.en: CogAdapt begins with code for which we have both human-comprehension measurements and model responses. We use the NoviceVsExpert corpus ( Peitek et al., 2022 ) , in which participants read Java programs while EEG and eye movements were recorded. We then process the same programs with each MoE code model. This gives us two views of the same code: how strongly humans respond while reading it and how strongly different parts of the model respond while processing it.
paragraphs.zh: CogAdapt 从一段我们同时拥有人类理解度测量数据和模型响应的代码开始。 我们使用了 NoviceVsExpert 语料库（Peitek 等人，2022），其中参与者阅读 Java 程序的同时，研究人员记录了他们的脑电图和眼动数据。 接着，我们用每个 MoE 代码模型处理这些相同的程序。 这样我们就获得了同一代码的两个视角：人类在阅读时对其的响应强度，以及模型不同部分在处理时的响应强度。

paragraphs.en: We obtain two complementary signals from synchronized eye-tracking and EEG recordings of 37 participants reading 32 Java programs ( Peitek et al., 2022 ) . Eye tracking identifies which code tokens participants inspect, how long they look at them, and when they look back or revisit them. From the EEG recordings, we extract theta-band power ( 4 4 – 8 8 Hz) and standardize it within participants. We aggregate theta over the corresponding semantic code regions. These signals describe where readers concentrate their attention and the neural activity associated with reading individual regions or an entire program.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 37 名参与者阅读 32 个 Java 程序时的同步眼动追踪和脑电图记录中获得了两种互补的信号（Peitek 等人，2022）。 眼动追踪可以识别出参与者检查了哪些代码标记、注视它们的时间长短，以及他们何时回看或再次查看这些标记。 我们从脑电图记录中提取 theta 波段功率（4–8 Hz），并在每位参与者内部进行标准化处理。 我们将 theta 波段功率在对应的语义代码区域上进行汇总。 这些信号描述了阅读者将注意力集中在何处，以及与阅读单个区域或整个程序相关的神经活动。

paragraphs.en: We process the same Java programs with each MoE model and record five responses at each candidate block: expert-choice concentration, expert-choice change, hidden-state shift, MoE write strength, and residual update strength. Their exact definitions and aggregation are given in Section 5.2 . These quantities describe routing and representation changes at code locations. We compare them with human measurements to examine correspondence, without assuming that response magnitude directly identifies an optimal adaptation location.

paragraphs.en: EEG is resampled to 100 Hz, filtered at 0.5–40 Hz, channel-screened, and common-average referenced. 4–8 Hz theta is measured using median Hilbert log power across six nonfrontal regions, averaged over 0–1 s after backward-fixation onset relative to a − 0.8 -0.8 to − 0.2 -0.2 s baseline. Local theta and dwell/regression/revisit summaries are standardized within participant and aggregated at mapped tokens. Welch theta log-power changes relative to the − 5 -5 to − 1 -1 s pre-code baseline are averaged across nine regions, standardized within participant and time bin, and averaged across participants and 12 normalized reading bins. Fixations are mapped to visible code spans using image geometry and each model’s tokenizer offsets.

paragraphs.en: Because the human data are collected on Java while our downstream tasks are written in Python, we do not transfer scores through exact token matching. Instead, we transfer attention through syntactic correspondence. We represent code elements using their syntactic roles and AST context and associate structurally similar elements across the two languages. For a downstream token, its human-attention prior is therefore determined by the attention observed for syntactically similar elements in the human-study programs. This design follows the idea established by prior approaches: human reading behavior is converted into reusable supervision for code-model training ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由于人类数据是在 Java 上收集的，而我们的下游任务是用 Python 编写的，因此我们不通过精确的标记匹配来传递分数。 相反，我们通过句法对应关系来传递注意力。 我们使用句法角色和 AST 上下文来表示代码元素，并将两种语言中结构相似的元素关联起来。 因此，对于某个下游标记而言，其来自人类注意力的先验值由在人类研究程序中观察到的、句法相似元素的注意力决定。 这一设计遵循了先前方法所确立的理念：将人类的阅读行为转化为可用于代码模型训练的可复用监督信号（Zhang et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Different coding tasks may benefit from adaptation in different parts of the model. To identify these locations, we first pass each training prompt and its reference solution through the pretrained MoE model. For each transformer block, we measure how the MoE router changes its selection of routed experts, how much the block changes its internal representation, and how strongly the selected experts contribute to the block output. We summarize these responses at sampled solution positions and normalize them within each task so that the different signals can be compared on a common scale. The previous analysis tells us which depth ranges tend to show stronger human–model correspondence. We summarize this pattern into a model-specific depth prior and use it as one source of evidence when ranking blocks for a new task. The resulting ranking identifies the blocks favored by the selection policy for that particular task. We also decide how much adaptation capacity to allocate. Higher-demand tasks receive slightly more blocks, while lower-demand tasks receive fewer. We compute it once before fine-tuning and reuse it whenever the task appears during training.
paragraphs.zh: 不同的编码任务可能通过模型不同部分的适配而受益。 为了确定这些位置，我们首先将每个训练提示及其参考解决方案输入预训练的 MoE 模型。 对于每个变换器块，我们衡量 MoE 路由器如何选择路由专家的变化、该块内部表示的变化程度，以及所选专家对该块输出的贡献强度。 我们在采样后的解决方案位置上对这些响应进行汇总，并在每个任务内对其进行归一化，以便不同信号能够在统一尺度上比较。 上述分析告诉我们，哪些深度范围倾向于表现出更强的人机对应关系。 我们将这一模式总结为模型特定的深度先验，并在为新任务排序各块时将其作为证据来源之一。 由此得到的排序能够识别出该特定任务中受选择策略偏好的块。 我们还会决定分配多少适配容量。 需求较高的任务会获得稍多的块，而需求较低的任务则获得较少的块。 我们在微调前计算一次该值，并在训练期间每次出现该任务时重复使用它。

paragraphs.en: CogAdapt applies the task-specific block mask obtained in Stage 3. Although the full model participates in the forward pass, only the adaptation parameters within the selected blocks are allowed to receive gradients for the current example. The pretrained MoE experts remain frozen, while lightweight attention adapters and router parameters in the selected blocks are updated. Human signals determine what training information should receive greater emphasis , while the task-dependent block mask determines where the resulting learning should occur . paragraphs.en: Our evaluation follows the progression from human–model correspondence to its practical use in model adaptation. RQ1 first examines whether developers and MoE models respond more strongly to the same code regions. RQ2 then examines where this correspondence appears across model depth and human reading stages. These two analyses provide the empirical motivation for task-dependent block selection. Finally, RQ3 evaluates whether using this information for cognition-informed sparse adaptation can improve code-generation accuracy while reducing the training resources required for adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估遵循从人类与模型对应关系到其在模型适应中的实际应用的演进过程。 RQ1 首先考察开发人员和 MoE 模型是否对相同的代码区域表现出更强的响应。 接着，RQ2 考察这种对应关系在模型深度和人类阅读阶段的不同位置上如何体现。 这两项分析为任务相关的代码块选择提供了经验性依据。 最后，RQ3 评估了利用这些信息通过认知指导的稀疏适应方法，是否能在提升代码生成准确性的同时减少适应所需的训练资源。

paragraphs.en: We use the NoviceVsExpert corpus ( Peitek et al., 2022 ) , a controlled code-comprehension study with 37 participants. Participants read 32 Java programs of varying difficulty and answered questions about their behavior while their eye movements and EEG signals were recorded. This provides complementary views of human code comprehension: reading time captures the overall effort spent on a program, eye tracking shows which parts of the code receive attention, and EEG provides a measure of neural activity during comprehension. At finer granularity, we align eye fixations with the code being viewed and summarize how long readers look at each location, how often they revisit it, and when they look back to an earlier part of the program. We normalize these attention measures within each participant before combining them across readers. We further group nearby tokens into 81 semantic code regions, allowing human and model responses to be compared at the same meaningful code locations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 NoviceVsExpert 语料库（Peitek 等人，2022），这是一项包含 37 名参与者的受控代码理解研究。 参与者阅读了难度各异的 32 个 Java 程序，并在回答有关程序行为的问题时，其眼动和脑电图信号被同步记录。 这为人类代码理解提供了互补的视角：阅读时间反映了理解一个程序所需的总体努力程度，眼动追踪显示了代码中哪些部分获得了关注，而脑电图则提供了理解过程中神经活动的衡量指标。 在更精细的层面上，我们将眼动注视点与正在查看的代码进行对齐，并总结读者在每个位置停留的时间、重复访问该位置的频率，以及何时回看程序的早期部分。 在将这些注意力指标跨不同读者合并之前，我们首先对每位参与者内部的指标进行了标准化处理。 我们进一步将相邻的语元分组为 81 个语义代码区域，从而使得人类和模型的回答能够在相同的有意义代码位置上进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that cognition-informed sparse adaptation can improve code generation while reducing the number of parameters updated during training. We next discuss why this selective adaptation may be effective, its current computational limitations, and directions for extending sparsity beyond model adaptation.

paragraphs.en: CogAdapt’s gains suggest that adaptation quality depends on where updates occur, not only on how many parameters receive gradients. Model responses identify blocks relevant to each task, while human-derived difficulty priors control the adaptation budget. Restricting each example’s updates to these blocks may reduce interference with representations useful for other tasks, while preserving the pretrained expert weights. Human-derived task and token weights further concentrate supervision on examples and code regions associated with greater processing demand. Together, these mechanisms may help a smaller per-example adaptation budget produce more useful updates. CogAdapt’s improvements over both all-block fine-tuning and fixed sparse baselines support the value of task-dependent selection.

paragraphs.en: CogAdapt reduces the number of parameters that are eligible for gradients for each training example, but the full backbone still participates in the forward pass. Consequently, the reduction in wall-clock time and energy is smaller than the reduction in adaptation parameters. This distinction suggests an important next step: connecting cognitively informed adaptation with conditional model execution. For example, future systems could extend sparsity beyond standard MoE routing. While an MoE model already selects only a subset of experts within each MoE block, the full sequence of transformer blocks still participates in the forward pass. A future system could additionally use human-informed signals to decide which blocks or adapters should participate for a given task, or whether some block-level computation can be skipped entirely. Combining expert routing with conditional block or adapter activation, early exiting, or other forms of dynamic execution could therefore translate CogAdapt’s adaptation sparsity into larger training and inference savings.

paragraphs.en: We present CogAdapt, a cognition-informed framework that uses human attention and EEG signals to guide task-dependent sparse adaptation of MoE code models. Our analysis shows that human processing and model computation correspond both at individual code regions and across model depth, although the specific patterns differ between architectures. Rather than assuming a single universally aligned layer, CogAdapt transfers these cognitive signals as priors to guide what training examples and code regions receive more emphasis and where adaptation occurs within the model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CogAdapt，这是一个基于认知理论的框架，它利用人类注意力和脑电图信号来指导 MoE 代码模型的任务相关稀疏自适应。 我们的分析表明，人类的处理过程与模型的计算过程在单个代码区域和模型深度层面都存在对应关系，尽管具体模式在不同架构间存在差异。 CogAdapt 并未假设存在一个唯一且普遍对齐的层，而是将这些认知信号作为先验知识进行迁移，以指导哪些训练样本和代码区域应获得更多关注，以及自适应应在模型的哪个部分发生。

paragraphs.en: Across two MoE backbones and two code-generation benchmarks, CogAdapt achieves the best pass@1 among the evaluated methods. Compared with regular fine-tuning, it improves LiveCodeBench pass@1 by 10.86 percentage points for Qwen and 6.29 points for GLM. Our ablations further show that these gains are not explained by sparse fine-tuning alone: using all blocks, fixed random blocks, or model-only block selection generally performs worse than the full CogAdapt, while removing EEG or attention guidance also reduces performance in most evaluated settings. At the same time, CogAdapt reduces per-example gradient-eligible adaptation parameters by 86.21–87.21%, together with reductions in training time and estimated GPU energy. Overall, our findings show that human comprehension signals can provide useful guidance not only for what a model should learn from, but also for where learning should occur.
